business_overview.one_sentence: Emperor Capital is a Hong Kong financial services group covering global financial markets, financing, equity research and corporate finance advisory services.
business_overview.revenue_model: Brokerage and financial market services generate commission and fee income; financing generates interest income from margin, IPO financing, loans and advances; corporate finance generates advisory fees.
business_notes: This is a regulated financial services business, so client money and segregated account balances are not ordinary detachable cash.
The 2025 placing and underwriting commission on bond instruments was accompanied by a large disposal loss on related bond instruments.

non_recurring_items.item: Loss incurred under global financial markets business from disposal of financial assets at FVTPL obtained from placing and underwriting services
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Bond underwriting related disposal loss, paired with placing and underwriting commission revenue

years.note: Operating cash flow was dominated by loan book reduction, segregated account and client payable movements, and interest received.
Operating cash flow also benefited from loan book reduction and interest received.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow is not a clean ordinary free-cash-flow proxy for a securities and financing group because customer money, margin/client payables and loan book movements are embedded in operating activities.

evidence.note: Client money in segregated bank accounts.

gaps: Annual report does not split general-account cash by regulated subsidiary, holding company, minimum liquid capital or immediate dividend capacity.
Only 2024 and 2025 detailed cash-flow lines were extracted from the current annual report; older years were available only as summary profit/loss and balance sheet totals.
Maintenance regulatory capital requirement was not disclosed in the extracted annual report text and is estimated conservatively in the owner-earnback analysis.
